A team of students made *Tile Garden*, a calm puzzle game for phones.
Players play **5 minutes** at a time. The team has money for one more
platform: PC, console or cloud gaming.

## Task 1 · Platforms (2 marks)

a) Write one strength and one limit of a **console** for *Tile Garden*.
(1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) A player wants to play *Tile Garden* through cloud gaming with a ping of
**90 ms**. What is the total delay? Is it a problem for this game? Why?
(1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · Three criteria (3 marks)

| criterion | PC | console | cloud |
|---|---|---|---|
| reach | 4 | 2 | 3 |
| fit for the game | 4 | 3 | 5 |
| cost and time | 5 | 1 | 3 |

a) Add up the total of each platform. Which one comes first? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) Give a reason for the score 1 of the console in "cost and time", and for
the score 5 of the cloud in "fit for the game". (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

c) The team wants players to continue their garden on the new platform
with the same account. Which feature is this, and what is the work of
adapting the game to the new platform called? (1 mark)
